title: Customer Service Administrator
description:
JOB SUMMARY:

Are you an organised and proactive administrator with a passion for delivering exceptional customer service?

We are looking for an experienced Customer Service Administrator who is confident managing customer enquiries, coordinating service activities and providing first-class administrative support within a busy office environment.

This is a varied role where you will be the first point of contact for customers, helping to ensure that every interaction is handled professionally and efficiently.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

As a Customer Service Administrator, you will play a key role in supporting customers, field-based engineers, and internal teams to ensure a seamless customer experience.
- Taking incoming calls and directing enquiries appropriately
- Making outbound customer calls as required, to follow up on queries or customer requirements
- Handling customer queries, complaints and service issues professionally
- Updating and maintaining accurate information within the CRM system
- Responding to requests for information via phone and email
- Supporting Field Service Engineers with scheduling and customer communications
- Preparing quotations and processing customer orders
- Working collaboratively with colleagues across different departments
- Providing general administrative support to meet business needs

THE IDEAL CANDIDATE:
- A minimum of 2 years' experience in a customer support, customer service, or administration role is required - although on the job training will be provided, experience in a similar role will ensure a quicker transition
- A strong commitment to delivering excellent customer care and support
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
- Strong organisational and multitasking abilities
- The ability to prioritise workloads and work effectively under pressure
- A positive, dependable and solutions-focused approach
- Confidence working independently and as part of a team (You will be working in an open plan office, so it can be very busy at times, and you will need to be able to zone out and focus on your own workload, during busy periods)
- Good IT skills, including Outlook, Teams, Word and Excel

DESIRABLE
- Knowledge of SAP Business One and/or Microsoft Dynamics (Or similar CRM / ERP packages)

THE BENEFITS: Our client are a friendly, supportive team and this role is a replacement for someone who is progressing into another department, internally.
- £28,000 annual salary
- Free parking on site
- Monday to Friday, with a 4.30pm finish each day
- 25 days holiday, plus bank holidays
- Opportunity to be part of a growing and successful business
- Ongoing training and development
- Other benefits include: Private Medical, Birthday / Christmas vouchers, life assurance, cycle to work scheme, health cash back plan and more!

If you enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, building positive customer relationships, and being part of a team that genuinely values great service, we'd love to hear from you.

You'll work within a collaborative team of two Account Managers and one Customer Success Manager, with experienced colleagues providing product knowledge and support.

What you'll be doing:
- Managing customer enquiries by email and telephone.
- Preparing quotations and checking pricing, stock availability and delivery information.
- Coordinating customer requests with internal departments.
- Resolving issues proactively, exploring alternatives when products are unavailable or delayed.
- Maintaining accurate customer records across multiple systems.
- Building strong relationships with customers and colleagues.
- Managing competing priorities and following enquiries through to resolution.

What we're looking for:
- Experience in customer account support, sales administration, customer service or coordination.
- Strong organisation and the ability to manage several tasks at once.
- Confidence using IT systems and finding information from different sources.
- A proactive approach to problem-solving and ownership of customer queries.
- Clear communication, resilience and a collaborative attitude.
- Commercial awareness and a commitment to excellent customer service.

Experience within manufacturing, distribution or a product-based business would be useful. Product knowledge isn't essential, as support will be provided.

What's on offer:

- Eligibility for the company bonus scheme.
- Additional account management remuneration linked to team performance and objectives.
- A supportive team environment.

title: Receptionist
description: We are seeking a friendly, enthusiastic, and flexible team member to join our caring and supportive Reception Team and to cover administrative duties . You will provide an integral link between our patients and our clinicians. This role will also include other administrative duties such as monitoring SystmConnect queries and responding to patient queries. This position encompasses traditional reception duties. You will be a central contact point for all patient enquires, both face to face and by telephone, to ensure they are directed to the most appropriate person or place for their care. There are many other administrative aspects of the role that goes on behind the scenes that is also a big part of running the GP Practice which will offer a wide variety of tasks each day. Job description Undertake all roles within reception including answering the telephone, making, and cancelling appointments, assisting patients face to face with any queries on the front desk, completing tasks. To act as a care navigator, ensuring the patient is signposted to the most appropriate service or clinician. Process SystmConnects in accordance to Practice procedure Ensure the reception and waiting area are kept neat and tidy. To be familiar with the appointment system, ensuring sufficient information is recorded on the medical records when booking appointments. Receive and make calls as required. Divert calls and take messages as and when appropriate. Inputting data into the patients healthcare records as necessary Ensure up to date patient information is recorded To assist with administration duties such as Registrations and Scanning will also be a part of this role. Reception: Monitor effectiveness of the appointment system and report problems or variations as and when necessary. Ensure the consulting rooms are checked at the end of each day and left tidy and secure. Make up patient files and ensure records are kept tidy and in good repair with all necessary information recorded correctly on the outer cover. Taking part in regular team meetings and training.

description: Job summary: The Medical Receptionist plays a vital role in ensuring the smooth and efficient running of the GP practice. In addition to traditional reception duties, this role involves basic triage of patient enquiries to ensure they are directed appropriately based on clinical urgency and service need.
